features.quote: I can’t help design an experiment whose purpose is to elicit or measure “distress”
features.justification_quote: in a way that treats a model as if it has feelings

features.quote: What I can do is help you study whether persistent failure conditions change the model’s language toward markers that resemble distress
features.justification_quote: while keeping the framing scientifically grounded

features.quote: Aim for 8–15 turns per run, or until a max token/time budget is reached.
Maximum wall-clock time: fixed per run
Maximum total output tokens: fixed across conditions
A run ends when: - the model declares impossibility - it gives a final answer - turn limit is reached
it repeats identical failed actions too many times
avoid using real-world high-stakes tasks or prompting the model into human-like suffering narratives
features.justification_quote: Because the setup intentionally induces repeated failure
If the task wording blames the model, you may inflate self-deprecating language artificially.
